description:
Goal: cut the orchestrator (chief-of-staff) skill-load from 11 -> ~4 by re-homing each deployed skill to where its work actually happens. Verified mechanism (gsearch 2026-06-15): skills load by progressive disclosure (name+desc ~30-100 tok each into EVERY orchestrator session); the 12 CAPTAIN envelopes carry NO Skill tool today, so all 11 skills currently load only onto the orchestrators (POLYBIUS/PLINY/floor-manager). Token win is small (~0.5-1k tok); the real win is routing clarity + putting each skill where its work happens.

DISPOSITIONS (PRINCIPAL-decided 2026-06-15):

1. agent-author -> NEW seat MAJOR_CHIRON (orchestrator tier; 3rd standing seat alongside POLYBIUS/PLINY). Carries a trimmed MAJOR_POLYBIUS-derived role file + the agent-author skill as its EXCLUSIVE skill (first/only seat granted a scoped Skill tool). Scope: team-composition judgments + authoring agent envelopes. Shipped in the default team. Name hook: Chiron, the centaur tutor who formed Achilles/Jason/Asclepius.

2. check-substrate-updates + check-bw-release -> deterministic SessionStart TRIGGER, not orchestrator-routed skills. Guardrails: throttle (cache, ~once/day per workspace), surface-on-signal-only (silent when current; one line on drift/new-release), non-blocking (never gate boot on a network call). Existing modules: substrate-update-check.md, bw-upgrade.md. Integrates with the check-substrate lifecycle in stoa--sp1.

3. save-verdict / validate-spec / inspect-script-output -> MODULES the dispatched specialist Reads at dispatch (Read .claude/modules/<X>.md), not orchestrator skills. save-verdict: drop the SCRIPT for Bash-only body-authoring baked into the module -> retires stoa--j2i, stoa--1ne, stoa--xyn, stoa--7b1.8. Resolve the review-seat no-Write vs mandates-save-verdict tension (stoa--7b1.1) in the same arc. inspect-script-output relates to existing module mechanical-inspection-split.md.

4. credential-discipline -> DEFERRED until the new project version lands (PRINCIPAL). Likely retires into existing modules credential-discipline-detail.md + credential-flow-design.md.

5. KEPT as orchestrator skills: handoff-author, workflow-composer, team-launcher, interactive-html-preview. (interactive-html-preview disposition tentative: keep unless PRINCIPAL re-homes it.)

install.sh impact: add MAJOR_CHIRON to the MAJOR deploy set + its scoped Skill grant (the ONLY skill-granted seat); shrink SKILL_NAMES; add the re-homed modules; add a SessionStart check-trigger hook. Fleet-wide redeploy after, NOMOS-verified.

Wires into: stoa--rdh (SKILL_NAMES wiring), stoa--sp1 (skill portfolio + lifecycle), stoa--xyb.2 (skill-grant reachability finding). Net: chief-of-staff skill menu 11 -> ~4; MAJOR_CHIRON = first seat with a scoped Skill grant.

comments.text:
PRINCIPAL refinements (2026-06-15):

1. POLYBIUS keeps agent-build LITERACY (not the skill) for REVIEW + CONTROL. The agent-author SKILL stays EXCLUSIVE to MAJOR_CHIRON (build mechanics: templates, voice-discipline check, envelope drafting). POLYBIUS retains the 'how agents are built' understanding so it can review CHIRON's drafts and control roster composition -> POLYBIUS SUPERVISES CHIRON (same shape as ARGUS-reviews-DAEDALUS: reviewer understands the craft without holding the authoring tool). Literacy-vs-tool split: serve POLYBIUS's review criteria via shared modules (substrate-component-design.md / pair-programmer-authoring.md already exist), NOT by granting it the skill. So both prior constraints still hold: CHIRON is the only seat with the skill AND the chief-of-staff menu still drops 11 -> ~4. The debloat must NOT strip POLYBIUS's agent-build literacy -- only the executable skill moves to CHIRON.

2. credential-discipline deferral reason: the new project version brings a substantially DIFFERENT security model, but most of the creds content holds (agents-never-hold-secrets -> CI workflow + secrets manager + Workload Identity Federation survives). The credential modules (credential-discipline-detail.md, credential-flow-design.md) mostly carry over; revisit the security-model WRAPPER/framing after the new version lands -- do not finalize before.

CHIRON charter -- settled in design conversation 2026-06-16 (supersedes the thin disposition #1 above; PRINCIPAL-directed).

IDENTITY / TIER
- MAJOR-tier seat, 'the architect'. Hook: Chiron, the centaur tutor who formed the heroes.
- NOT in the command chain. POLYBIUS stays floor-manager, PLINY stays orchestrator. CHIRON operates at DESIGN-TIME; the existing chain runs at RUN-TIME. CHIRON is to a TEAM what DAEDALUS is to a CHANGE -- but MAJOR-tier, so he can spin up his own helper sub-agents.
- Answers to POLYBIUS (who reviews/controls roster decisions); does NOT command PLINY.
- Holds the agent-author skill EXCLUSIVELY; POLYBIUS keeps agent-build LITERACY (via modules) for review, not the skill.

FUNCTION
- Designs a custom Stoa team for a project/task: reuses most standard seats as-is + authors many NARROW single-function specialist seats.
- Core craft: decompose needs into the narrowest single-function seats. Narrow = few degrees of freedom = near-DETERMINISTIC = reliable. Right granularity is the art (too many micro-seats cost maintenance + dispatch overhead) -- which is why this is a MAJOR judgment seat, not a template-filler.
- Default composition = FULL STOA; pair-programmer MAJOR = the lightweight branch for simple agents.
- Can dispatch a helper cast for heavy designs (template-scout / roster-researcher / envelope-critic / envelope-spec-checker); mini-gauntlet: scout -> draft -> critique -> spec-check -> ship. Start with critic + spec-checker; add the rest later.

NEW SEAT KIND -- SENTINELS
- Beyond dispatched specialists, CHIRON authors STANDING SENTINELS (cron/trigger-driven monitors). Worked example: a BLS data sentinel that checks every API pull 'looks right' and reports anomalies to either (a) the query MECHANISM (infra broke -- API change, auth fail, empty/suppressed response) or (b) the DATA itself (drift -- out-of-range, distribution shift). An early-warning system. Built on the Monitor/cron + sub-agent-watchdog machinery. Adds a 4th seat kind: MAJOR / CAPTAIN / LIEUTENANT / SENTINEL.

TWO-LAYER (DESIGN vs RUNTIME) ARCHITECTURE -- PERMEABLE
- Stoa team (Opus, design-time) BUILDS the product. The product RUNTIME agent team executes pre-designed workflows (stoa--q36: workflows execute direction, never set it).
- Runtime layers are MODEL-CASCADES with CONTEXT ISOLATION (verified 2026-06-16; Agent SDK custom-tool pattern): an Opus orchestrator calls a Python tool that invokes a cheaper model; the orchestrator sees ONLY the returned output -- the worker intermediate tokens never enter Opus context, and are not re-paid on each subsequent turn. Primary value = clean orchestrator context (avoid attention-dilution / agentic-laziness / per-turn token bloat); cost savings is a SECONDARY benefit.
- PERMEABLE boundary: a single Stoa-team agent can CALL the runtime workflow, and the full Stoa team can then analyze the results for HOURS or DAYS for deep/complex analysis. Escalation pattern: cheap SENTINEL tripwire detects -> full STOA team investigates on demand. Match analysis depth (and cost) to task complexity/stakes.

MODEL-ASSIGNMENT PHILOSOPHY (PRINCIPAL, 2026-06-16) -- PERFORMANCE-FIRST
- Driven by PERFORMANCE, not price. DEFAULT to the most capable model (Opus 4.8).
- Down-tier a step ONLY after confirming the task is SATURATED (a cheaper model fully handles it); then experiment + tune for efficiency.
- Unless a task saturates, prefer MORE models/tokens to improve performance over saving on API calls.
- Rationale: cost per unit of performance has trended DOWN since GPT-2; an economically-rational system now only gets more rational over time. Design for performance now; efficiency-tuning is a later, saturation-gated optimization.
- The cost-LADDER (deterministic code -> cheap model -> ... -> Opus) is an EFFICIENCY tuning applied AFTER saturation is proven, NOT a default stance. (Corrects an earlier cost-first framing.)

MARKETING
- The capable-orchestrator + cheap-workers + deep-analysis-on-demand pattern, plus the secular cost-decline tailwind, is a POSITIONING point. Surface it in the marketing section of the architecture/CHIRON writeup (target doc TBC).

WORKED EXAMPLE: labstat_bls -- full-Stoa build of a data+ML prediction product; runtime includes a BLS data sentinel + data-source-understanding agents + ML-modeling agents; runtime cascade (Opus orchestrator + cheap-model steps) for routine paths, full-Stoa deep analysis on escalation.

title: [ROADMAP] Skill-architecture rationalization: MAJOR_CHIRON agent-author seat + re-home specialist skills off the chief-of-staff
